shapeVolume: Distinct irregular chunky debris, coherent main facet planes and softer edges; readable three-dimensional turning volume in every required facing and state. Useful changes to proportions, topology, piece construction and decoration are welcome inside the reconciled functional design budget.
color: Maintain blue/cyan and violet/purple identity across the moving burst. Warm cream/gold highlights may enrich crowns and edges without bleaching large areas or turning the whole effect orange. The palette must remain readable on light, gray and dark backgrounds.
lightingHighlights: Broad soft light and controlled plane/edge highlights give solid volume without preferred horizontal lighting or directional ground shadows. Lower facets retain color and readable volume, avoiding black wedges, noisy specular flicker and flat uniformly bright surfaces.
materialDetail: Facet hierarchy and restrained bevel/edge softness communicate polished cartoon stone or crystalline reef debris. Optional small chips and crafted plane breaks must survive intended size; thin glowing seams and dense microdetail are not goals by themselves.
readabilityArtifacts: At logical 320x448 and representative phone half-scale, the burst must remain an open readable scatter with meaningful separated pieces and no clipping, halos, black patches, coplanar flicker, sudden scale pop or camera-facing impostor. Retain clean real transparency.
motion: Preserve the authored windup, outward active burst, recovery shrink, 12 frames each at 12fps, nonloop terminal clamp and native facing transforms. Check all frames, including transitions and final held frames. A repeated review playback is presentation only; no loop-closing requirement is invented for these one-shots.
hardConstraints: Root and frame registration, camera projection/pixel aspect, published 2x sourceScale, exact 6x2 atlas rect/order and N/E/S/W capture rotation remain fixed.
Native geometry/material/light changes must render coherently from all views. No frame fitting, crop shifts, recolor, alpha/RGB repair, painted sprite substitutes or runtime helper changes.
Use real measured enabled raw/evaluated geometry and motion bounds to let root define the design envelope. Nominal 1x1 metadata and height 0.9 alone are not per-frame geometry size locks.
No support floor, opacity law, joins, ports or attachment family constraints are added where none exist.
approvalGate: Actual native required-view/frame evidence, registered current-consumer logical/phone/background evidence, actual playback inspection, passing immutable native capture contract and no material visual defects. This preparation does not approve any candidate, family, production or Godot integration.
